verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a government agency whose employer services, such as quarterly tax and wage filing, are delivered through online portals. However, the evidence documents only interactive web portal (EAMS/SecureAccess Washington), paper, email and fax channels. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and showed the transactional host redirecting every keyless request to an authenticated login page, so nothing shows a headless, CI or API mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
